results.content: Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 28, leaving him underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 126,586 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term.
